component.name: Appbox
component.summary: Web app manager with one isolated session per app

description.p: Appbox keeps your web apps in one window, each in its own isolated session, with a sidebar to switch between them. Cookies, storage and logins never mix, so two accounts of the same service can live side by side.
It ships a built-in Gmail client that talks IMAP directly, since Google does not allow its web interface inside embedded browsers, and a GitHub tracker that lists the pull requests waiting on you.
Appbox runs on the system Electron package, so where the distribution packages Electron the Chromium security updates come from the distribution rather than from a bundled runtime.
